operations.description: This resource returns offers that are available to the user and conform to the search criteria (if specified).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] matchedoffers [PARAMS] category fid items lang merchant name number offer page per token type user [SCHEMA] items matched offer offers response

operations.description: This resource returns extended information for the requested offer, typically used to display a detail view.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] offerdetails [PARAMS] fid id offer token user [SCHEMA] credit detail details display media merchant offer postpaid response

operations.description: This resource returns offers that have been fulfilled by the user.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] redeemedoffers [PARAMS] fid items lang number page per token user [SCHEMA] items offer offers redeemed redemed reedemed response

operations.description: This resource returns extended information about the specified activated postpaid credit offer.
operations.summary: Returns Information About Redeemable Postpaid Credit Offer
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] statementcreditactivationdetail [PARAMS] activation fid id token user [SCHEMA] activation credit response sc statement

operations.description: This resource returns the accumulated and potential savings for a Personalized Offers user.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] usersavings [PARAMS] fid token user [SCHEMA] credit offer offers prepaid response savings statement user

operations.description: This resource creates the user session. It must be called prior to any other API calls for the specified user. The Token value does not expire.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] usertoken [PARAMS] auth fid info [SCHEMA] response token user

operations.description: This resource is used to make a statement credit offer available for redemption.
operations.summary: Make Statement Credit Offer Available Redeemable
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] activatestatementcreditoffer [PARAMS] fid id offer token user [SCHEMA] activate activation offer response sc

operations.description: This resource allows a user to provide a thumbs-up or a thumbs-down rating of the specified offer. Offer matches that are disliked will be supressed from the results of future calls to Matched Offers.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] userfeedback [PARAMS] feedback fid id offer token user [SCHEMA] feedback response user
